name: Strong Pig 36
author: neerajbaniwal
description: Gradient rounded white button that slides on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, transform becomes translateX(7px). On focus, outline becomes 2px solid #fefefe, box-shadow becomes 9px 9px 44px #cecece3a, -9px -9px 44px #d3d3d33d,
    inset 0 0 0 2px #c0c0c0.
